headline: Tecnotree Recognized in Two Gartner® Hype Cycle™ Reports for CSP Algorithmic Pricing
summary: ESPOO, Finland, July 28, 2026--Tecnotree, a global digital platform and services leader for AI, 5G, and cloud-native technologies, today announced that it has been recognized in the CSP Algorithmic Pricing use case in the Gartner Hype Cycle for Emerging Technologies in the Communications Industry, 2026 report and in the CSP Algorithmic Pricing, CSP Digital Marketplaces and AI for CSP Customer Interactions use case in the Hype Cycle for Telco Cloud Services, 2026.
